notes:
• Auto-OCR after import (Settings ▸ General): scanned PDFs and images are recognized right after import, with progress in the status line — search and translation work without Tools ▸ OCR.
• Privacy master switch (Settings ▸ General ▸ Security): “Never send documents to cloud AI services” hard-blocks translation, summaries, handwriting reads and cloud transcription for every provider except local Ollama; Apple transcription stays on-device.
• AI summaries: choose the output language (app language, document language, English, German, French) and length (short / standard / detailed) under Settings ▸ Translation.
• Jurisdiction-aware functions: a matter's convention now hides what doesn't exist in that jurisdiction — Bates numbering outside arbitration, German evidence offers outside DE/AT/CH — and there is a new England & Wales convention. Settings ▸ General ▸ “Show all functions” overrides.
